ignoreRulesReasons.border-accent-on-rounded: Standing kit-wide waiver. The rule fires on an accent border on a rounded element, but only from its top/bottom arm — it is structurally incapable of firing on a left or right border (impeccable 3.6.0, cli/engine/rules/checks.mjs checkBorders). market-pulse.md's own 'colored left-border callout boxes' entry names a top border as the sanctioned escape from that anti-pattern, so the rule penalises the pattern the design bar recommends. side-tab still enforces the actual enemy (left/right stripes) down to 2px, and loses nothing from this waiver. Accepted cost, named deliberately: a thick (3-12px) accent stripe on the TOP or BOTTOM of a rounded element is now unenforced, because side-tab's horizontal-stripe arm only runs when border-radius is 0.
